title: Improve dark mode switch contrast (#66759)
body:
**Title:** Improve dark mode switch contrast (#66759)

## Summary
Unchecked switches can blend into dark surfaces, which makes the Dag pause toggle difficult to distinguish in dark mode. This adds a token-based dark-mode border to the shared switch control while keeping the light-mode off state transparent and the checked state on the existing color palette border.

## Changes
- **`airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/src/theme.ts`** -- add an emphasized border to the shared Chakra switch recipe so unchecked switches remain visible in dark mode.
